```{r, message=FALSE}

rerun_dge_analyses = F
```

```{r}
scData.combined <- readRDS(file.path(data_storage_folder, "ZhangIM_and_GutCellAtlas_HealthyAdult_Epi_BBKNN_CC_adjusted.RData"))
scData.combined$condition <- ifelse(scData.combined$DS=="ZhangIM", scData.combined$condition, "Gut") |> factor(levels=c("Non-atrophic gastritis","Chronic atrophic gastritis","Mild intestinal metaplasia","Severe intestinal metaplasia","Gut"))
scData.combined@meta.data$condition_and_region = factor(ifelse(scData.combined$DS=="ZhangIM", as.character(scData.combined$condition), paste0(as.character(scData.combined$condition), "-", as.character(scData.combined$Region))) , levels = c("Non-atrophic gastritis", "Chronic atrophic gastritis", "Mild intestinal metaplasia","Severe intestinal metaplasia","Gut-SmallInt","Gut-APD","Gut-LargeInt","Gut-REC") ) 

scData.combined@meta.data$cluster_label_old <- ifelse(scData.combined$DS=="ZhangIM", scData.combined$cluster_label, scData.combined$annotation)

```

# Final cluster assigment

```{r}
cluster_assignment = read.table(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Cluster_assignments/Cluster_assignments_Epi_only_IM_and_intestine_BBKNN_2025-04-03.txt"), sep="\t",header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
options(width = 180)
print(cluster_assignment)
rownames(cluster_assignment) = as.character(cluster_assignment$ClusterID)

cluster_assignment$Label = factor(cluster_assignment$Label, levels=sort(unique(cluster_assignment$Label)))

scData.combined = AddMetaData(scData.combined, cluster_assignment[as.character(scData.combined$seurat_clusters),"Label"], col.name = "cluster_label")
scData.combined = AddMetaData(scData.combined, cluster_assignment[as.character(scData.combined$seurat_clusters),"Type"], col.name = "cluster_type")

scData.combined$cluster_label <- factor(scData.combined$cluster_label, levels=c("Sto gland base","Pit cells 1","Pit cells 2","Pit cells 3","Intestinal stem cell","Enterocyte DD","Enterocyte proximal","TA/Colonocyte","BEST4+ epithelial","Colonocyte AQP8","Colonocyte FABP1","Colonocyte MUC5B","Goblet cell","Paneth","Enteroendocrine","Tuft"))

scData.combined = SetIdent(scData.combined, value="cluster_label" )
```

```{r}
plot_top_genes <- function(data, dge_results_all, title) {
  for (n in sort(unique(data$cluster_label))) {
    tmp = subset(dge_results_all, cluster==n)
    if(nrow(tmp)<1) next
    tmp_up = subset(tmp, avg_log2FC > 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_up)<1) next
    tmp_up$direction = "up"
    #tmp_down = subset(tmp, avg_log2FC < 0)
    #tmp_down$direction = "down"
    
    #final_top_genes = rbind(head(tmp_up,10), head(tmp_down,10))
    final_top_genes = head(tmp_up, 10)
    final_top_genes = final_top_genes[order(final_top_genes$avg_log2FC),]
    final_top_genes$gene = factor(final_top_genes$gene, levels = final_top_genes$gene)
    p = ggplot(final_top_genes, aes(y=avg_log2FC, x=gene, fill=direction)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, ", ", title)) + coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.y =  element_text(size=12) )
    print(p)
    
  }
}
```

```{r}

plot_genes <- function(dataset, genes, split.by=NULL) {

  all_genes =rownames(dataset@assays$RNA)

  for (g in sel_markers) {
    if (!g %in% all_genes) {
      print(paste0("Gene ",g," has no data (possibly filtered out)."))
      next
    } else {
        p1  =FeaturePlot(object = dataset, features = g, reduction="umap", split.by=split.by, label=T, sort=T)
        p2 = VlnPlot(dataset, features = g, ncol = 1, pt.size = 0.01, split.by = split.by) + NoLegend()
        if (is.null(split.by)) {
          print(plot_grid(p1,p2, ncol=2,align="h"))
        } else {
          print(plot_grid(p1,p2, ncol=1,align="v"))
        }

    }
  }
}
```


# Marker exploration

## Selection markers and markers of epithelial and contaminating cells

These are markers used in the cell sorting to select cells for scRNA analysis. Cells were sorted as Lgr5+ eGFP cells from Lgr5-EGFP-IRES-CreER(T2) mice. Since eGFP will be expresed in the offspring of cells positive for Lgr5 at the time of Cre induction, we would expect mainly epithelial cells to be selected.


```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
sel_markers=c("LGR5","AXIN2","EPCAM","PTPRC","CD34","VIM", "MYH11", "ASCL2")
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "RNA"

#plot_genes(scData.combined, sel_markers)
DotPlot(scData.combined, features = sel_markers, cols="RdYlBu", assay="RNA") + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```



## Epithelial subgroup markers

Cd44, Sox2, Lgr5 - Lgr5+ signature  
Muc6 - gland base cells  
Gast, Ghrl, Chga - G-cells  
Dclk1 - Tuft cells  
LIPF - Chief cells  
Pgc, Gif  - Chief cells
Tff1 (stomach surface), Tff2 - pan stomach epithelial cell markers  
Tff3 - intestinal (goblet cell) marker  
FABP1 - intestinal differentiated cells  
ATP4A,ATP4B - Parietal  

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
sel_markers=c("CD44","SOX2","LGR5","MUC6","MUC5AC","GKN1","GKN2","GAST","GHRL","CHGA","PGC","GIF","MUC2", "DCLK1", "TFF1","TFF2","TFF3","FABP1", "LIPF", "ATP4A","ATP4B","KRT19")
```
